base_url.description: Base URL where bepasty will be publicly accessible (including protocol, e.g., https://paste.example.com)

upload_dir.description: Absolute filesystem path where uploaded files are stored

secret_key.description: Random, cryptographically secure secret key used for signing sessions and tokens. Must be generated and kept secret.

public_enabled.description: Enable the public file upload form (anyone can upload if not rate-limited)

listing_enabled.description: Enable file listing for authenticated users (e.g., admins)

default_expiration.description: Default upload expiration time in seconds (e.g., 86400 = 24 hours). Use 0 for no expiration.

max_file_size.description: Maximum allowed file size in bytes (e.g., 104857600 = 100 MB). Use 0 for unlimited.

max_uploads_per_ip_per_day.description: Maximum uploads allowed per IP address per 24-hour window. Set to 0 to disable.

rate_limit_enabled.description: Enable per-IP rate limiting (applies only if max_uploads_per_ip_per_day > 0)

allowed_mime_types.description: List of allowed MIME types. Empty list = allow all types. Example: ['text/plain', 'image/png', 'application/pdf']

inline_mime_types.description: List of MIME types that should be displayed inline in the browser instead of forcing download.

database_url.description: Database connection URI (SQLite, PostgreSQL, etc.). Example: 'postgresql://user:pass@localhost/bepasty'

session_cookie_secure.description: If true, cookies will only be sent over HTTPS. Recommended for production with HTTPS.

session_cookie_samesite.description: SameSite cookie policy: 'Lax', 'Strict', or 'None'. Use 'None' only with Secure flag.

workers.description: Number of Gunicorn worker processes. Set to 0 to auto-detect (based on CPU cores × 2 + 1).

bind_address.description: IP address to bind the HTTP server to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces (requires reverse proxy in production).

port.description: Port number for the HTTP server.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stderr instead.

admin_enabled.description: Enable the admin UI for managing uploads and configuration.

items.description: Username or email of an admin user (e.g., 'admin@example.com' or 'superuser')

admins.description: List of admin users who can access the admin UI

password_protection_enabled.description: Allow uploaders to protect their uploads with a password (optional field in public form)

min_password_length.description: Minimum length required for upload passwords (if enabled)

cleanup_expired_enabled.description: Automatically delete expired uploads during scheduled maintenance.

cleanup_unclaimed_enabled.description: Delete uploads that were not claimed (i.e., no metadata set) after a delay.

cleanup_unclaimed_after_seconds.description: Seconds after which unclaimed uploads are deleted (only if cleanup_unclaimed_enabled=true).

captcha_enabled.description: Enable reCAPTCHA v2 for public uploads to mitigate spam.

captcha_provider.description: CAPTCHA provider. Currently only 'recaptcha-v2' is supported.

recaptcha_site_key.description: reCAPTCHA v2 site key (required if CAPTCHA_ENABLED=true and CAPTCHA_PROVIDER='recaptcha-v2')

recaptcha_secret_key.description: reCAPTCHA v2 secret key (required if CAPTCHA_ENABLED=true and CAPTCHA_PROVIDER='recaptcha-v2')

registration_enabled.description: Enable user registration for the built-in auth backend (if used).

email_verification_enabled.description: Require email verification before user accounts become active.

smtp_server.description: SMTP server host for sending registration or notification emails.

smtp_port.description: SMTP server port (typically 587 for TLS, 465 for SSL, 25 for unencrypted).

smtp_from.description: Sender email address used for system emails.
